name: Khana Khazana
why_it_matters: Long-running multi-cuisine place opposite Siliguri Junction railway station beside Hotel Heritage — a default first/last meal for travellers transiting through NJP and the Tenzing Norgay bus terminus across the road.
insider_tip: Beside Heritage Hotel branch is the original; the Sevoke Road outlet is a separate franchise of similar name. Order north Indian here; the Chinese is competent but not the kitchen's strength.
signature_address: Beside Heritage Hotel, opposite Siliguri Junction, Hill Cart Road, Pradhan Nagar, Siliguri 734003

name: The Wok Monk
signature_dish: thai red curry with jasmine rice
why_it_matters: Behind Planet Mall in Bankim Nagar — Siliguri's most consistent Pan-Asian and Thai kitchen on Sevoke Road. Dim sum trolleys at lunch on weekends; the curries lean closer to Bangkok-style than the indo-fied versions further down the strip.
insider_tip: Weekend lunch dim sum stops at 3pm; arrive by 1:30pm. Khao soi (northern Thai noodle soup) is a sleeper order — not on every menu printing, ask the waiter.
signature_address: Sevoke Road, behind Planet Mall, Jyoti Nagar, Bankim Nagar, Siliguri 734001

name: Hakka Fusion
why_it_matters: On the Sevoke Road Don Bosco stretch — locally rated as Siliguri's most authentic Hakka-Chinese kitchen. Pan-Asian items added later but the kitchen's Hakka roots show in the wok finish.
insider_tip: Ground floor of the Aatalika Building — easy to walk past; entrance off Sevoke Road. The lunch buffet on weekdays is the value play (₹350-450 per head).
signature_address: 2.5 Mile, Aatalika Building, Ground Floor, Don Bosco Modh, Sevoke Road, Siliguri 734001

name: WOW! China
why_it_matters: Sevoke Road outlet of Wow! Momo / Wow! China — the Kolkata-founded QSR chain that turned the steamed momo into a national fast-food category. Reliable when other Sevoke Road kitchens are full.
insider_tip: Order on the chain's app for combos; the in-store walk-in pricing runs 10-15% higher. Avoid the cheese-fondue momos — the spicy steamed and pan-fried versions are what the brand does best.
